attributes.description:
Background for the entire wizard. Gives multi-step flows a single visual frame so users can focus on one stage at a time.
CSS variable: --wm-wizard-background

Color of the wizard's outer border. Use transparent for a minimal look, or a subtle contrast color so the flow stands out on busy pages.
CSS variable: --wm-wizard-border-color

Border style for the wizard shell: none hides it; solid, dashed, or dotted change how strong the outline feels.
CSS variable: --wm-wizard-border-style

Thickness of the wizard outline. Heavier borders draw more attention to the step-by-step area.
CSS variable: --wm-wizard-border-width

Corner rounding for the wizard. Matches cards and panels so the flow feels consistent with the rest of the UI.
CSS variable: --wm-wizard-border-radius

Shadow around the full wizard. Light elevation helps users notice the flow and separates it from surrounding content.
CSS variable: --wm-wizard-shadow

Space between the wizard edge and its inner content. Extra padding reduces crowding and improves readability.
CSS variable: --wm-wizard-padding

Minimum height of the main step content. Stops the panel from jumping between short and tall steps so the experience feels stable. Use px, em, rem, or vh.
CSS variable: --wm-wizard-body-min-height
